nameEn: Manufacture of starches and starch products
description: This class includes the wet milling of corn and other cereals to produce starch and starch derivatives, glucose and glucose syrups, gluten and gluten feed.
includes: manufacture of starches: corn starch, potato starch, tapioca starch, wheat starch, etc.
manufacture of glucose, glucose syrup, maltose, inulin
manufacture of tapioca and tapioca substitutes prepared from starch
excludes: manufacture of grain mill products, see 1061
